title: Visa Application Form to Enter Japan

portal.label: Get the form from the embassy

before: Download the application form from your Japanese embassy's website and fill it in typed or in block capitals. It's a paper form: there is no online portal for residents of Lebanon.
The boxes below follow the form from top to bottom. Leave nothing blank: write N/A where a box doesn't apply.
Book your appointment with the Embassy of Japan before you go; the Beirut visa section only sees applicants by appointment.

fields.label: ID number issued by your government
fields.note: Write N/A if your passport shows none.

fields.label: Date of departure
fields.note: The form asks for the intended length of stay: count the days between these.

fields.label: Hotel or person you'll stay with: name, address, phone
Previous stays in Japan
fields.note: If Yes, give the dates of your last stay.

sections.title: Your home and work
yourself: Partner's profession or occupation (or parents', for a minor)

sections.title: Guarantor and inviter in Japan

fields.label: Guarantor: name, address, phone, relationship, status in Japan
fields.note: Write N/A if nobody is inviting you.

yourself: Guarantor's date of birth, sex, nationality and occupation, as on their letter

sections.title: Questions and signature
yourself: The yes/no questions on criminal convictions, deportation and other offences
Date and sign the form yourself

after: Bring the signed form, a 45 x 35 mm photo glued on it, your passport and the documents on your checklist to your appointment.
The embassy may call you for an interview. You pay the fee only if the visa is issued.
Collect your passport in person and record the decision on your dashboard.
